title: AI Infra Index plugin entry
description: One file per plugin under plugins/<id>.yaml. This is the canonical record.

schema.description: Entry schema version. Breaking changes bump the major registry version.

id.description: Stable slug. Decoupled from repo/package names; renames go through aliases.

kind.description: DSH plugin (installable via dsh plugin add) or a library consumed by plugins.

collection.description: Reserved for future multi-index support. First version is always ai-infra.

package.description: Package name as declared in the repo's package.json.

summary.description: One sentence for README and site listings.

stages.description: Lifecycle stages covered. Must exist in taxonomy.yaml.

order.description: Optional display order within a category; lower first. Default 100.

status.description: Maturity. Staleness is an operational signal, not a status.

install.description: One copy-paste shell block. For stable entries it must be a single command.

install_note.description: Optional caveat, e.g. not yet on npm.

backends.description: Serving/training backends this entry was verified against.

proves.description: What the entry demonstrates, in one line.

fails.description: What happens when the proof does not hold (degrade, rollback, refuse).

url.description: Deep link to the verification section or report, not the repo root.

verified_at.description: Date the maintainer last ran the gate. Not a file mtime.

verified_by.description: xiciyang for maintainer-verified; future community entries use community:<handle>.

superseded_by.description: Required for deprecated entries when a replacement exists.

aliases.description: Old ids, repo names, or package names kept for rename safety.
